verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly publishes a pricing page with a $0/mo-forever tier. It states that seats are not a cost driver: unlimited seats, with pricing based on usage. It defines some usage units, such as AI Runs and monthly session replays and errors, and a community user confirms MAU-based charging. The evidence does not show paid-tier prices or per-unit rates for MAUs, events or requests, so a PM cannot fully estimate cost before committing. Missing for 10: published paid-tier prices, documented per-unit rates for MAUs/service connections/requests/events, a cost calculator or worked examples, independent corroboration of the pricing model.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can see published pricing and understand what drives cost (seats, MAUs, events, requests) before committing

citations.quote: No per-seat pricing. Invite your whole team; pricing is based on usage.
$0/ mo, forever... Unlimited seats... Unlimited feature flags
